method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Rates.title: United States annual producer inflation rises to 6.5% in October vs. 6.6% expected
Rates.summary: Producer inflation in the United States (US), as measured by the change in the Producer Price Index (PPI), climbed to 6.5% in October from 6.3% in September, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday. This print came in slightly below the mark
Rates.reason: Direct US inflation datapoint that sustains Fed hike expectations -> upward pressure on Treasury yields (bond selloff / higher-for-longer).

Rates.title: Fed’s Daly sees more rate hikes as firms seek to pass on costs

Rates.reason: Senior Fed official explicitly signals a bias toward higher rates, reinforcing expectations of further hikes and upward pressure on yields.

Rates.reason: Another influential Fed voice flagging broader inflation and more policy work -> pads the higher-for-longer Treasury yield narrative (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Fed's Collins warns inflation is broadening, backs careful rate hikes
